english_text: Are they blind? Our allies are firing on our units!
czech_text: Jsou slepí? Spojenci střílejí na naše jednotky!

english_text: The eagle falls! Germanicus is slain!
We have killed the enemy commander!

czech_text: Ať je na vás Athéna hrdá!

english_text: Care! There are marked traps afoot!
Traps are near! Proceed with vigilance!
We have taken control of the enemy base!
The men return to our cause!
czech_text: Muži se vracejí k naší věci!

english_text: We are firing upon allies! Cease!
Mighty Leonidas has breathed his last!
Find the feet of our enemies!
The mercenary Xanthippus breathes his last!
The men are fleeing the battlefield!
Time is short! We must fight!
Arminius has fallen under our fire!
We must fan the flames of war.
We must take their base from them, or scatter their forces to the four winds!
czech_text: Musíme jim vzít základnu, nebo rozprášit jejich vojsko do všech větrů!

english_text: Traps lay near! Tread with caution!
Stop firing! Our arrows find allies!
czech_text: Přestaňte střílet! Naše šípy zasahují spojence!

english_text: Allies fire upon us! Cease fire!
czech_text: Spojenci po nás pálí! Zastavit palbu!

english_text: The end of the battle is nigh!
We must cease fire! Our allies are in there!
czech_text: Musíme zastavit palbu! Jsou tam naši spojenci!
